verdict.rationale: turbopuffer is API-first. First-party docs cover an API overview with dashboard-issued tokens, async operations via the `Prefer: respond-async` header, and documented write, query, namespace and metadata endpoints. It also ships official SDKs in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java, Ruby and Rust, and publishes a public OpenAPI spec in an official GitHub repo from which those clients are generated. The OpenAPI 404s at website paths do not contradict this, because the spec is hosted on GitHub. Missing for 10: a stable public OpenAPI contract (the repo README warns the spec is mainly for internal use and may break at any time), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
